title: Polymer Coating Reactor Simulation
description: A virtual chemistry lab where the user operates a carbon fibre substrate coating reactor. The user must mix reagent concentrations, control temperature and pressure, apply clear-coat polymer layers onto a carbon fibre sample, and manage conservation of mass across the reaction chamber while using undo/redo to correct mistakes across a multi-step synthesis protocol.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) implementing a chemistry lab polymer coating reactor. Load CarbonFibre.glb as the substrate sample mounted on a rotating platform at center-stage, and ClearCoatCarPaint.glb as the coated reference target displayed on a side pedestal for visual comparison. Use OrbitControls with the camera starting at position (0, 3, 6) looking at origin. Add three-point lighting: warm key light, cool fill, and rim light, plus an emissive glow on the reactor chamber walls. Build a reactor UI overlay (HTML/CSS) with: (1) three reagent sliders (monomer A 0-100ml, catalyst B 0-50ml, solvent C 0-200ml) that must obey conservation of total volume = 250ml (adjusting one auto-constrains others), (2) a temperature dial (20-400°C), (3) a pressure gauge (1-10 atm), (4) an 'Apply Coat Layer' button that visually adds a translucent clearcoat shell around the carbon fibre model using a MeshPhysicalMaterial with clearcoat=1 and increasing clearcoatRoughness per layer, (5) an undo and redo button stack tracking all parameter changes and coat applications. The user must apply exactly 5 coating layers with specific parameter windows displayed as target ranges on each slider. Each coat application locks current parameters into a history stack. The carbon fibre model should visually transform: layer 1 adds slight gloss, layers 2-3 deepen reflectivity, layers 4-5 approach the reference ClearCoatCarPaint appearance. Show a similarity percentage comparing substrate to reference using clearcoat and roughness delta. Animate a particle effect (small spheres) swirling inside the reactor during each coating step. Display a mass-balance readout proving reagent conservation. The task completes when all 5 layers are applied within target ranges and similarity exceeds 90%. Add a reset button to restart the entire protocol.
